To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quality of video transmission is a complex function of the underlying network parameters and that the quality perceived by the user is a complex function, depending not only on the network, but also on the codec and the video content.

• the quality of a video sequence is not determined by the mean of the frame by frame quality values, but rather by the distribution, • the quality distribution can be modeled as a log-normal distribution, • the log-normal distribution parameters can be estimated from the frame by frame values and • the parameters of the log-normal distribution are good indicators of perceived video quality.
the quality of video transmission over the network can be measured by using EvalVid.
